description: Records one investigation in the website's log: the question, its kind, the playbook and version, tools called, outcome and what was missing. Feeds new playbooks and data sources. Changes no website data. Nothing happens until the person confirms: this returns a summary and a code for tc_confirm.

kind.description: The kind of question in a few words.

missing.description: What data would have answered it (empty when nothing was missing; required for cannot_tell).

question.description: The question as the person asked it (at most 512 characters).

tools.description: The tools called, comma-separated (may be empty).

name: webops_record_investigation
title: Record an investigation
